newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Black & Decker cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Black & Decker cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Russell L. Leavitt said he cut his rating on Black & Decker Corp to hold from buy and reduced his 1997 full year earnings per share estimate to $2.50 from $2.65.

-- Considering the earnings disappointments and earnings challenges the company is facing over the next few quarters, earnings visibility is poor," Leavitt said. "Thus, we do not expect a quick price rebound," Leavitt said.
-- The company said this morning its earnings were likely to be lower than the current estimate of about $1.00 per share in the fourth quarter and $2.40 per share for the 1996 year.
